svg.title: Bodman Outfits
svg.desc:
The browser-tab mark: an italic B in Fraunces, the site's own display face, on the brand's everglade ground with a copper ring.
The letter is a PATH, not a text element, and that is the load-bearing decision. A favicon renders outside the page's font context, so a text element depends on a font being installed on the reader's machine - the earlier version asked for Georgia and would have fallen back to whatever the system had, differing per visitor. An outline renders identically everywhere and needs nothing installed.
The glyph is the real Fraunces italic, extracted from the OFL-licensed family already shipped in public/fonts, instantiated at opsz 144 - the display optical size, where the thick-thin contrast is highest. A synthetic slant of the roman was rejected: skewing a high-contrast serif shears the stress angle without rotating it, which reads as a mistake rather than an italic.
Drawn for 16px. Editing note: keep documentation in desc, never an XML comment - naming a CSS custom property inside a comment introduces a double hyphen, which is illegal in XML and silently renders the icon unparseable while still serving 200.
